testCases.title: Login with valid credentials
testCases.expectedResult: User is logged in and redirected to dashboard

testCases.title: Login with invalid password
testCases.expectedResult: Error message shown, user stays on login page

testCases.title: Login with empty fields
testCases.expectedResult: Validation errors shown for both fields

testCases.title: Login with unregistered email
steps: Enter email that is not registered
testCases.expectedResult: Error message: account not found or invalid credentials

testCases.title: Register with valid data
steps: Fill in all required fields with valid data
testCases.expectedResult: Account created successfully, confirmation email sent

testCases.title: Register with existing email
steps: Enter email that is already registered

testCases.title: Password strength validation
testCases.expectedResult: Password strength indicator shows weak, submit is blocked or warned

testCases.title: Request password reset with valid email
testCases.expectedResult: Reset link sent to email, success message shown

testCases.title: Request password reset with unregistered email
testCases.expectedResult: Generic message shown (no info leak about which emails exist)
